noCodes: Tufts publishes no building-code list: the AS&E registrar pages (students.tufts.edu/registrar) have none, and the official Medford/Somerville campus map (campusmaps.tufts.edu/docs/Tufts_Medford-Som_Map.pdf) indexes buildings by name and map grid only (checked 2026-11-07).

excludeHalls.1023-beacon-street: SMFA at Tufts residence on Beacon Street by Kenmore Square in Boston, about 6 km from the Medford/Somerville campus; its students' classes are at the SMFA building on the Fenway (Tufts first-year housing page lists it under SMFA).
